name: AI Agents Directory
conditions: Free $0/forever listing requires placing the AI Agents Directory badge with a backlink on your site; the listing goes live permanently only after badge verification.
Free tier includes a dedicated product page and 1 category placement, but the outbound link is no-follow.
requirements: Product must be an AI agent or agent-related tool; the directory is organized by categories such as Coding, Sales, Marketing, SEO, Video, Voice.
Submission must fit one of the directory's categories (free tier gets 1 category placement).
Site describes itself as a curated marketplace with verified listings — expect editorial review before publication.
preparation: Agent name, website URL, description, use cases, and pricing model (the submit form asks for agent name, what it does, use cases, pricing, and link).
Logo/product imagery for the dedicated product page.
Decide free vs paid first: free requires the AAD badge already live on your site for verification; Fast Track $19 skips the badge and review wait.
An email for contact (hello@aiagentsdirectory.com is their listed contact).
workflow: Open https://aiagentsdirectory.com/submit-agent (linked as 'Submit' in nav and footer).
Fill the submission form: agent name, what it does, use cases, pricing, and link.
If on the free plan, embed the AAD badge with backlink on your site so it can be verified.
For paid routes, choose a plan on /sponsor (Fast Track $19 one-time; featuring packages with newsletter/social promotion) and pay via Stripe.
Wait for editorial review; paid plans advertise skipping the review wait.
watchFor: The /submit-agent page is JS-rendered — form fields were not visible to a plain HTML fetch; expect a client-side form.
Free listing's outbound link is explicitly no-follow; do-follow requires a paid plan.
Badge must remain on your site for the free listing to stay live (badge verification is the gate).
The /sponsor page shows upsells: 'Skip badge requirement', 'Skip review wait time', 5-day website featuring, newsletter promotions, social promotion.
Header shows 'Advertise · 6/6 left' — limited sponsor slots is a scarcity upsell, not a requirement.
countsAsLive: A dedicated agent profile page is publicly reachable under the directory (e.g. under /agents or /category/<cat>) and the listing appears in browse/search without a pending state.
unknowns: Exact field list and validation rules of the submit form (JS-rendered; not observable without a browser).
Whether an account is required to submit.
Review duration for free submissions (only that paid 'skips review wait time' is stated).
Full price list of sponsor/featuring packages beyond the $19 Fast Track.
